remarks: First floor one level living in this pristine beautifully updated unit located in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Featuring open floor plan, great closet space, gleaming hardwood floors throughout, updated kitchen with Cherry cabinets and granite countertops, marble bath, newer A/C wall units freshly painted and hardwood floors were just refinshed- all you need to do is unpack! Large dining room is ideal for entertaining guests or easily converted to a home office. Washer/dryer in unit and a separate storage unit is included. Ample free off street parking and garage parking is available for rent $85/month through HOA. This is a pet-friendly complex with amazing privacy. Enjoy the beauty of the 13 park-like acres and the convenience of an in-town location close distance to the Metro North train, Greenwich Ave, Whole Foods, award winning restaurants, and world-class shopping.
